name: event-ticketing-system
description: Event Ticketing System - Full Stack Application

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:infra
scripts.deploy:frontend: npm run build:frontend && cd infra && npx cdk deploy EventTicketingStackFrontendStack8E3A3C69
scripts.deploy:backend: cd infra && npm run clean:verify && npx cdk deploy EventTicketingStackDatabaseStack8C978210 EventTicketingStackAuthStack8C9D77AA EventTicketingStackApiStackD88CF0AB EventTicketingStackApiDocsStack --outputs-file ../cdk-outputs.json && npm run config:frontend
scripts.deploy:infra: cd infra && npm run clean:vefiry && npx cdk deploy --all --outputs-file ../cdk-outputs.json && npm run config:frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run build:frontend && cd infra && npm run clean:verify && npx cdk deploy --all --outputs-file ../cdk-outputs.json && cd .. && npm run config:frontend
scripts.clean: npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:infra
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../infra && npm install
